title: Restriction on use of enhanced coverage

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that may support restriction on use of enhanced coverage and indicates this support in ATTACH REQUEST and TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST messages.

entities.name: Mobility Management Entity
entities.description: Network entity that indicates whether use of enhanced coverage is restricted in ATTACH ACCEPT and TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT messages.

entities.name: ATTACH REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message used by UE to indicate support for restriction on use of enhanced coverage.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message used by UE to indicate support for restriction on use of enhanced coverage.

entities.name: ATTACH ACCEPT
entities.description: NAS message where MME indicates whether use of enhanced coverage is restricted.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT
entities.description: NAS message where MME indicates whether use of enhanced coverage is restricted.

entities.name: Restriction on use of enhanced coverage
entities.description: Operator-imposed restriction preventing specific subscribers from using enhanced coverage to manage network resources.

entities.name: NB-S1 mode
entities.description: Narrowband S1 mode where UE shall indicate support for restriction on use of enhanced coverage.

entities.name: WB-S1 mode
entities.description: Wideband S1 mode where UE supporting CE mode A or CE mode B shall indicate support for restriction on use of enhanced coverage.

entities.name: CE mode B
entities.description: Coverage Enhancement mode B that may be restricted or not restricted for the UE.

relations.description: UE indicates support for restriction on use of enhanced coverage in ATTACH REQUEST message.
UE indicates support for restriction on use of enhanced coverage in TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.
MME indicates whether use of enhanced coverage is restricted in ATTACH ACCEPT message.
MME indicates whether use of enhanced coverage is restricted in TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message.
If enhanced coverage is restricted, UE shall not use enhanced coverage in registered PLMN and equivalent PLMNs.
When in NB-S1 mode, UE shall indicate support for restriction on use of enhanced coverage.
When in WB-S1 mode, UE supporting CE mode A or CE mode B shall indicate support for restriction on use of enhanced coverage.
If UE supports CE mode B and network determines enhanced coverage is not restricted or CE mode B is not restricted, applicable NAS timer values are calculated by network.
